first.text: A lost soul, fallen through the veil. Cast into the world of manifested thought...
And you look about as lost as they come.
Worry not, lost one. You'll find your way home when the time is right.
Though your path will surely be long, and lined with adversity.
You will need to defend yourself against the many spirits who will stand in your way.
Violence does very little to defeat one's spirit.
To subdue your foes, you'll need to ARGUE.

after_battle.text: Go on now, lost one. Find your way home.
